#⃣🔟$200,000 to @ChampionsSFV for the Community Wellness Initiative in Pacoima.

This helps create a mental health department and provide counseling to individuals and families. https://t.co/CLQOdgNko8

Today, we’re celebrating the 12th anniversary of the Affordable Care Act. 

Since 2010, it has lowered costs, expanded coverage and delivered lifesaving protections to Valley families! #ThxACA

March marks the 50th Anniversary of the federal Senior Nutrition Program, which funds @_MealsOnWheels. 

To celebrate, I joined the Alicia Broadous-Duncan Senior Center in Pacoima to deliver warm food to Navy WWII Veteran Steve Lopez! https://t.co/Bg4njTLbWp

The #BidenBudget puts mental health front and center.

Today's announcement includes key items in our #988Implementation Act:
✔️Expanded Coverage and Reduced Costs
✔️More Mental Health Providers
✔️A Better National Suicide Prevention Lifeline
https://t.co/RHSSvCt1dA

My father died from diabetes ten days before our son was born. 

That's what this disease does - it robs time and life.

The #AffordableInsulinNow Act will save lives by helping millions afford the treatment they need. https://t.co/isgWCHys0D

Thanks to President Biden, healthcare is now more accessible and affordable for Valley families. 

His Executive Order will expand health coverage to nearly one million Americans and save families hundreds of dollars a month.
https://t.co/SMOyMo1ZLI

The Pano will have 91 units for homeless individuals. It will also have on-site supportive services designed to build independent living and connect people with community-based healthcare, mental health treatment and employment.

Here’s what it will look like: https://t.co/2gRuVuPwSA

Last night, the Senate PASSED my & @janschakowsky's Safe Sleep For Babies Act to protect our kids by banning life-threatening crib bumper pads and inclined sleep products. I can't wait for President Biden to sign it into law! https://t.co/loqPVFMduD

Today is #NationalBikeToSchoolDay! Biking to school is a great way to enjoy some exercise and time with friends or family. We hope everyone enjoys their ride today and remind drivers to be extra careful of cyclists on their commute. https://t.co/Rw7E6xctIQ

Stories like Erika's are exactly why I introduced the Safe Sleep for Babies Act.

Now that our bill passed both the House and Senate, we're one step closer to officially banning dangerous crib bumper pads and inclined sleep products from store shelves. https://t.co/k0yDYATjMb
Today President Biden signed my Safe Sleep for Babies Act into law. Parents will finally have peace of mind knowing unsafe inclined sleepers and crib bumpers are banned.

Every day Title 42 remains in effect is another day we abandon the idea that America is a beacon of hope for all who seek refuge.

This hateful and fear-mongering policy must end.

https://t.co/bNwCZ8fqeF

My SAFE Sleep for Babies Act is now a law that bans the sale of dangerous crib bumpers and incline sleepers. If you have purchased one of these products, please be aware that they are linked to nearly 200 infant deaths and pose a risk to your child.

https://t.co/wjaX5EV5U5

Millions of cancer survivors have life-long lymphedema as a result of their cancer treatment.
 
I am a proud supporter of the #LymphedemaTreatmentAct because recovery from cancer shouldn't lead to another medical battle. #NationalCancerSurvivorsDay https://t.co/IVcAqb9YgL

Grocery stores. Schools. Funerals. Hospitals. City streets. Parties. Bars. This isn't normal. We shouldn't have to fear shootings everywhere we go. 
 
This week, we’re voting to pass commonsense gun safety laws that make daily life safer for everyone.

https://t.co/yH3xYuHvYf

Unacceptable. This is exactly why our Safe Sleep for Babies Act will ban inclined sleepers from store shelves on November 12th.

https://t.co/Gz9C7p1ISi

Today @POTUS signed the PACT Act. This new law expands health care coverage for veterans exposed to burn pits or other toxins while serving our nation. Part of honoring our veterans is caring for them, and this legislation was long overdue.

Last month, the Biden Administration and @samhsagov announced over $88M in funds for youth suicide prevention and school programs like the Project Advancing Wellness and Resiliency in Education (Project AWARE). https://t.co/mlNGSnEbRX

September is Baby Safety Month: double-check the safety of products you buy for your baby, especially when shopping secondhand.

My Safe Sleep for Babies Act bans the sale of certain deadly incline sleepers & crib bumpers, but you might own one already

https://t.co/jZvqwcklpt

Today I had the honor of speaking with @SiemensHealth AMIG@S, leaders & innovators in healthcare. 

We discussed inequities that impact Latinos, and how Siemens and Congress are working to support treatment options and outcomes that work for everyone. https://t.co/gc22EruItV

It's time to stop HIV stigma.
 
On National Gay Men's HIV/AIDS Awareness Day, we raise awareness about testing, prevention and treatment. https://t.co/r2lVIC0Tvu
 
#NGMHAAD #StopHIVTogether https://t.co/d6vd3sshmY

I visited @ConnectwithECF in Arleta and met with leaders, teachers, children and parents who are a part of this learning community. 

We spoke about my Safe Sleep for Babies Act and how we can make homes and childcare centers safer spaces for kids. https://t.co/iYWdfCiBsu

Quality, affordable health coverage is a key to healthier communities. I voted for the #InflationReductionAct so that more Valley residents can access health coverage they can rely on — without breaking the bank. Just one more way I'm working to put #PeopleOverPolitics. https://t.co/N5sNJLnLe1

Spoke with Nannies Latinas about how nannies keep kids safe. My Safe Sleep for Babies Act and Magnet Injury Prevention Act will keep dangerous products out of the hands of children, and when caretakers know what to look for they can identify danger at home before it's too late. https://t.co/Bi7zxQjPQy

.@TiaChucha is creating a richer life for Valley residents through the arts. When they needed help getting funding for their Arts-based Community Wellness Programming, I connected them with @SenBobHertzberg. Happy to say they're receiving $800,000! https://t.co/W9RRoUBAaq
